script: Remember the guy who went viral for pretending to be Klay Thompson? At first he was just pranking some fans and even got reactions from the Warriors players. But when Golden State reached the finals again in 2022, he took the impersonation way further. It started with him trolling people outside the arena, but somehow security actually let him inside because he was covered in Warriors gear. They apparently thought he was Klay, and he ended up walking onto the court before the game. He even made a basket before the Warriors finally realized what happened and banned him for life.
